p.title: How fossil fuels formed
p.challenge: Put the steps in order to see why coal and petroleum are non-renewable

panels.t: Plants and animals lived and died long, long ago.
Their remains were buried under layers of mud and sand.
Heat and pressure acted on them for millions of years.
They turned into coal, petroleum and natural gas.
We burn them as fuel, and they cannot be replaced in our lifetime.
